objective: Restore BUKLOD MAIN DZAS radio browser playback recovery after two owner screenshots showed unsupported audio source errors; preserve native player and protect Expo Hosting release governance.
productionBaselineEvidence: Verified source-only: GitHub main 088df3cc1265a097744f78f4f24aaa3ae5ad3586 still has one Icecast browser URL and an unrelated native Zeno endpoint. The two owner screenshots on Nov 22 2026 show unsupported-source messages. Current production web is Expo Hosting https://buklod.expo.app as specified in docs/BUKLOD_DESKTOP_WEB_SOURCE.md, NOT Vercel. Browser audio transport endpoints were not independently playable from tool sandbox (curl DNS unavailable). No verified live web deployment or runtime playback exists for this patch.
chosenApproach: Isolate browser-only HTMLAudioElement startup with de-duplicated HTTPS source candidates, bounded 12-second per-source startup, cancellation and real playing-event confirmation. Preserve all native media, account, ad, and navigation behaviors. Add focused Node assertions and wire DZAS tests into existing source-verified Expo web release pipeline while preserving production embargo/identity gates.
selectionRationale: A single stale/unavailable source previously surfaced an unhelpful browser error and never attempted the existing native DZAS stream. Sequential fallback avoids parallel audio, unbounded retries or extra infrastructure; mandatory release gate regression tests protect later deployments without triggering release.
alternativeApproaches: Use the plain HTTP port-8000 directory stream: rejected because mixed-content and insecure redirects cannot be allowed in the HTTPS browser app.
Set up an unverified third-party audio proxy or paid transcoder: rejected to avoid restreaming/rights issues, extra egress expense and a new availability dependency.
Ship or merge unverified code directly to Expo production: rejected until explicit protected RC and real browser playback validation.
